A fixed-chemistry cross-volume response and named finite-q stationarity check are the next falsifiers; independent numerical/causal strengthening needed for grade4. proposed_contribution.falsifier: Reproduce the stated target and control with matched pseudopotential family, functional, cutoff, sampling and relevant spin/SOC treatment. Loss or reversal of the claimed response, instability of the target, or an unresolved competing phase changes the decision; ambiguous outcomes remain unresolved.
